verdicts.reason: A is just the original landscape layout shrunk into a thin band in the middle of the tall canvas: roughly 85% of the canvas is empty, and the speakers, venue and date text are illegibly tiny. B does reflow to a vertical layout and keeps the headline readable, but it breaks apart in several places. The grey panels have become empty, meaningless boxes. The C/torus artwork is split into disconnected scraps. 'Keaton Expo Centre' sits beside the speaker list with no grouping, while its address is stranded at the bottom. The second speaker column is indented out of line with the first. And the date block floats with no clear relationship to the rest.
